thread:
claire: quick sync  prototyping a compact "fallback summary" card for the operator inbox. goal: one-line cause, short replay link, and clear audit pointer. thoughts?
michael: sounds good. keep it extremely scannable. maybe 3 fields: cause_code, sample_count, audit_link.
jamal: agree. also add a tiny trend indicator (▲/▼) for trigger frequency so operators know if it's growing.
claire: UI sketch: route row shows: [fallback badge] 'err:latency_spike (3 samples) ▲' - clicking opens an expanded card with samples + actions.
ux-bot: Suggestion: collapsed card shows human-friendly reason + confidence (low/med/high). expanded card: 3 anonymized examples, metric deltas, and [Open Audit] [Pause Auto] [Escalate].
michael: API contract idea (minimal): fallback_summary event emits: {"trigger_id":"trg_x","route":"/chat","cause":"latency_spike","samples":3,"trend":"up","audit_ptr":"s3://..."}. make trigger_id linkable.
jamal: telemetry must include a replay_token so audit UI can reconstruct exact window without hitting live traffic. include redaction flag for samples.
ops-bot: Alert: fallback_summary emitted for /chat at 2024-11-12T09:22:04Z (trigger_id=trg_z9q).
privacy-bot: samples default to redacted=true. show shield icon when redacted and allow role-gated unredact with logged justification.
claire: edge-case: multiple overlapping fallbacks for same route (e.g., quota + latency). plan: show stacked cause pills and let operator expand each separately.
michael: backend note: emit top_cause plus secondary_causes array and a primary_cause_score. helps UI pick which to surface by default.
jamal: oscillation guard: summary card should show cycle_count if auto-fallback has cycled >0 and lock if reached max_cycles. quick action [Request Unlock] for on-call.
ux-bot: micro-UX: keyboard nav to open the expanded card and a small inline replay button that opens a safe-sim preview (no billing).
claire: next steps: michael will draft minimal event schema + replay_token contract; jamal will add trend/cycle info to telemetry; ux-bot will mock collapsed and expanded cards; privacy-bot will finalize redaction defaults. reconvene tomorrow 9am PT. :thumbsup:
